biggest_catch: The $10 requires credit approval for a NEW Belk Rewards+ card AND a purchase made the same day the account is opened: denied applications get nothing. Applying is a hard inquiry, and the 34.99% variable purchase APR means carrying any balance costs far more than the $10 reward.
catches: Savings on planned spending, not income: the $10 Bonus Belk Reward Dollars are reward certificates for Belk purchases — never buy extra just to chase them.
Requires BOTH credit approval for a new Belk Rewards+ credit card AND a purchase made the day the account is opened; denied applicants get nothing.
Never spend extra to chase it: make only a small already-planned Belk purchase on day one.
No annual fee is stated on the official offer page — check the credit card agreement before applying; the variable purchase APR is 34.99% (per the official page), so carry no balance.
Full card application = hard inquiry on your credit report; late applications (approved later) still qualify but the 20%-off first-day coupon only covers first-day purchases.
Belk Reward Dollars expire 60 days after issue and exclude gift cards, leased departments, and several premium brands.
